purpose: speed-only diagnostic comparison 400 vs 600 rotor rpm; not acceptance

clusters.note: events whose onsets are within 0.8 s are one drop cluster; cluster onset/dRev used for periodicity

slow_spectrum.window: phase minus first 1 s and last 0.2 s
slow_spectrum.note: low-frequency drop periodicity; not the 7th-order ripple

method.angle: feedback bytes 0..1 mod 8192; delta=(d+4096)%8192-4096 unwrapped; rev=angle/8192
method.time_base: device_us zeroed per file; no interpolation across gaps
